newer-corrigendum-deactivates-older.spec: I3 + R4: a newer filing of the SAME type deactivates the older one

older-filing-arriving-later-is-ignored.spec: I3 + E1: ordering is by filing_date, never by fetch order

same-sha-other-url.spec: I3 + R3: identical sha256 reached us by another URL - update the URL list only

late-drhp-supersedes-nothing.spec: I3: a DRHP discovered after the RHP supersedes nothing (DRHP precedence 10)

null-filing-date-kept-as-is.spec: I3: a same-type incoming with no filing date is not newer, so the held row stays

first-document-ever.spec: row 7 boundary: nothing held yet, so nothing can be superseded
